title: Business Hours Calendars: Define When You Are Open | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A queue that rings agents who have gone home, or a dialer that calls customers at night, wastes time and annoys people. A business hours calendar in CrestApps for Orchard Core defines when you are open, once, with a weekly schedule, a time zone and holidays, and queues, inbound entry points, dialer profiles and automated texts all follow it.

In this video:
• Why one shared calendar of opening hours
• Where a calendar is used: queues, entry points, the dialer and automatic activity loads
• Creating a calendar with a weekly schedule, a time zone and holidays
• Rules worth knowing: exclusive end times, 24 hours, past midnight, disabled calendars
• Use cases for support hours, calling windows and holidays
